metrics.G_pool: one model, all held-out images pooled into a single evaluation set, scored once
metrics.G_client_macro: one model, scored on each client's held-out split, unweighted mean over clients
metrics.G_client_weighted: as G_client_macro, weighted by each client's held-out image count
metrics.L_client_macro: each client's own post-training model on its own held-out split, unweighted mean over clients. This is the reported quantity under audit.
